### Borea v0.4.1

A security release for v0.4.0. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Security

- Borea now ships with the .NET runtime 10.0.13, the security release of 2026-10-13. Every Borea carries its own copy of the runtime, and 10.0.13 fixes six vulnerabilities in it, among them a remote code execution (CVE-2026-70197).
- Nothing else changes. The new features of the test builds stay for v0.5.0.
